[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.Stalkers.:main].Description
Mole: Wolf's Group - poorly organized squads of rookie stalkers located in the southern part of the Cordon. No one takes this group seriously. It will take skilled leadership and luck to overcome threats like the Military and Bandits.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersSeriy.:main].Description
Mole: Gray's Group - a small stalker group in the Hangar on the Garbage. On the verge of destruction due to bandits. Must find a way to survive without Strelok's help.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersBes.:main].Description
Mole: Bes's Group - a small stalker team in the south of the Garbage. Trying to hold a key location point. Surrounded on almost all sides by Bandits. The group is on the verge of destruction.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].Description
Mole: Diggers - a serious force at Agroprom. Must expand control around the base and capture artifact points for further successful development. Beware of the Military and "guests" from the Garbage.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDV.:main].Description
Mole: The Rotten - a suspicious stalker group from Dark Valley. They have a bad reputation. Rumors say they scam people out of money. Despite a decent location, they have several drawbacks, the most obvious being their proximity to the Bandit base.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersBar.:main].Description
Mole: Loners lack a clear hierarchy and a single leader. Their advantage lies in a predisposition for artifact hunting, which will greatly benefit their finances in capable hands. Located at the Rostok Factory. The faction must decide on its developmental priorities.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersMilitary.:main].Description
Mole: Masters' Group - several stalkers from Krivaya Balka at Army Warehouses. Their central location on the map allows for expansion in any direction. They face problems with stalker recruitment and desperately need to capture an artifact point.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].Description
Mole: Boar's Gang - a small gang based on the outskirts of the Garbage. They start by controlling an artifact point, which is a significant plus, but the lack of manpower forces them to seek expansion paths, which may lead to conflict with the main Bandit faction. Must find the right developmental vectors for this small faction.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.DutyCherep.:main].Description
Mole: Skull's Group - a splinter Duty detachment led by Colonel Skull. The squad consists of Duty's elite. They are also called "Duty Special Forces" due to their experience, training, and gear. The group declares its main goal as decisive action against Freedom, including capturing their base. Must decide on developmental priorities and prevent the squad from falling under Freedom's assault.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.Patrol.:main].Description
Mole: The Watch - a Mercenary squad guarding a checkpoint on the outskirts of Army Warehouses. Despite excellent weaponry, their survival prospects are doubtful against more numerous factions unless they focus on the economic side of the group.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsHunters.:main].Description
Mole: Trappers' Gang - a small Bandit group whose goal is to lure stalkers into traps to kill and rob them. Due to the small size of the group, survival chances are almost non-existent.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.Deserters.:main].Description
Mole: Deserters - military personnel who abandoned their posts for various reasons but remained in the Zone with highly uncertain prospects.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersLis.:main].Description
Mole: Fox's Group - a group with extremely doubtful survival chances. Based in the northern part of the Cordon.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.Zombie.:main].Description
Mole: Yantar Zombies - stalkers who fell under the emitter's influence at Yantar and became captives of the "Brain in a Jar".

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.ZombieRadar.:main].Description
Mole: Radar Zombies - stalkers who fell under the emitter's influence at Radar and lost their minds due to the "Brain Scorcher".

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.Crazy.:main].Description
Mole: The Madmen - those who say "I'm a fool and I have a certificate to prove it!"

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.Mercenaries.:main].Description
Mole: Volkodav's Squad - a large Mercenary detachment led by Volkodav. Holds a key location at the Wild Territory, features strong fighters and a steady resource flow. Such a squad is unlikely to face obstacles in the early game.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Mole: Well, sucker, had your fun? Time to face the music! The boys are comin' for ya!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Mole: Hey-hey! Bro, chill out, yeah? Time to stop shootin' at each other, capiche?

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Mole: Hey, Bro, how 'bout we team up, yeah? Y'know... shoot some guys together... and all that. Whaddya say? Deal?

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Mole: Nah, man, you're a real sucker, a total loser. From now on, everyone's on their own!

Mole: Hey, listen up, pal, got any spare change, yeah? We could use about this much:

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Mole: We'll find some – and cut it into strips!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Mole: Listen, we won't touch ya, word is bond, for real!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Mole: Nah, nah, that's totally not it, you're bluffing!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Mole: Hang tight, bro, everything's gonna be smooth real soon...

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Mole: Did you hit your head or somethin'? Where would we get that kind of cash! We could use some ourselves...

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
Mole: Bro, that was really uncalled for! Shouldn't have done that...

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.BanditsKaban.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes
Mole: Hey, bro, that's what I'm talkin' about! Good job...

Mole: Bro, that was really uncalled for! Shouldn't have done that...

Mole: Oh, bro, excellent! Now we'll be shootin' suckers together!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Mole: We wish to form an alliance with you. Do you agree?

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Mole: We've hit some financial difficulties. Could use some help. We're looking for a sum like this:

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Mole: You backstabbing rat! War it is, then!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Mole: We see no necessity for that at the moment.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Mole: Yes, we agree to a ceasefire.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Mole: We are not sure this is needed right now.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Mole: Regrettably, we are not in a position to provide that amount at this time.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Mole: Alright, we will transfer that sum to you.

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Mole: The faction has been completely wiped out. Now other factions will divide the Zone among themselves. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Mole: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-Krot].Name: [Groups.StalkersDiggers.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Mole: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!
